# Synthetic test fixtures

Every file below this directory is invented or a reduced synthetic protocol sample
created for automated tests. No file is a production export, Court document,
transcript excerpt, model response, credential, or private processing record. URLs,
dockets, captions, dates, and identifiers are test values even when they resemble an
official format.

New fixtures must remain minimal, contain no copied source body or private data, and
receive the same review as code. Binary PDF/audio/media fixtures are prohibited.
Static JSON fixtures additionally carry an explicit `_fixture.synthetic` marker.
